nameEn: Quarrying of stone, sand and clay
description: This class includes the extraction and processing of stone, sand, gravel, clay, and other similar materials used in construction and other industries. It includes quarrying operations and associated beneficiation activities.
includes: quarrying of clay and other minerals
excludes: extraction of ore and concentrates, see 0710, 0721
processing of mined minerals not associated with mining, see 2399
